question: Faheema is Jitesh's sister and Faheema's mother Aziza has only one brother, Muneer. Asma is the mother of Aziza and Suresh is the son-in-law of Asma. How is Suresh related to Faheema?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

Faheema is Jitesh's sister and Faheema's mother Aziza has only one brother, Muneer.

Asma is the mother of Aziza and Suresh is the son-in-law of Asma.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7cbe54063e89fbc4f2d08fb0dab7078c3611cd94aceb2fd15344af9ae3160b1.png] 

So, Suresh is the '**Father**' of Faheema.

Hence, the correct answer is "Father".
